scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && uv sync --project apps/api && docker compose -f infra/dev/compose.yaml up -d postgres postgres-test && pnpm exec playwright install chromium
scripts.dev:db: docker compose -f infra/dev/compose.yaml up -d postgres postgres-test
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn openvietgis_api.main:app --reload --no-access-log --app-dir apps/api
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head && uv run --project apps/api python tools/migrate_official_modules.py
scripts.validate:ts: pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test && pnpm --filter @openvietgis/web build && pnpm --filter @openvietgis/web-next build
scripts.validate:py: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api tools tests modules && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/openvietgis_api && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests/unit apps/api/tests/contract tools/tests tests/architecture tests/modules/test_house_numbering_domain.py
scripts.validate:integration: uv run --project apps/api python -m tools.run_with_test_database pytest apps/api/tests/integration apps/api/tests/performance tests/modules modules/house_numbering/tests/integration
scripts.validate:e2e: uv run --project apps/api python -m tools.run_with_test_database node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.validate:e2e:bootstrap: uv run --project apps/api python -m tools.run_with_test_database node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config playwright.bootstrap.config.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm validate:runtime && pnpm validate:ts && pnpm validate:py && pnpm validate:contracts && pnpm validate:scope && pnpm validate:arch && pnpm validate:docs && pnpm validate:integration && pnpm validate:e2e && pnpm validate:e2e:bootstrap && pnpm validate:e2e:offline && uv run --project apps/api python tools/check_secret_surfaces.py dist/security-evidence/playwright-p1.json dist/security-evidence/playwright-bootstrap.json && uv run --project apps/api python tools/check_tenant_timing.py dist/security-evidence/playwright-p1.json dist/security-evidence/playwright-bootstrap.json
scripts.validate:contracts: uv run --project apps/api python tools/check_contracts.py && pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/client-sdk/src/generated
scripts.dev:identity: docker compose -f infra/dev/compose.yaml -f infra/dev/compose.identity.yaml up -d postgres keycloak

scripts.generate:contracts: openapi-typescript ../../specs/002-identity-organization-tenancy/contracts/auth-session-api.yaml -o src/generated/auth-session.ts && openapi-typescript ../../specs/002-identity-organization-tenancy/contracts/tenant-core-api.yaml -o src/generated/tenant-core.ts && openapi-typescript ../../specs/002-identity-organization-tenancy/contracts/service-admin-api.yaml -o src/generated/service-admin.ts && openapi-typescript ../../specs/003-spatial-catalog-crs/contracts/spatial-catalog-api.yaml -o src/generated/spatial-catalog.ts && openapi-typescript ../../specs/004-map-workspace/contracts/map-workspace-api.yaml -o src/generated/map-workspace.ts && openapi-typescript ../../specs/005-import-export/contracts/import-export-api.yaml -o src/generated/import-export.ts

limitations: Relative JS/TS static import resolution only; runtime/dynamic string construction is not proven absent.
Cargo/pnpm/Python manifest graph is declarative and does not prove runtime use.
A zero reverse-import count is not deletion authorization; Docker, include_str/include_bytes, tests, scripts and external consumers require separate inventory.
